tools.name: sanctions-export-control_itar-usml-lookup
tools.description: Search 22 CFR 121 USML category headings and keywords. Returns category matches only — not an export classification determination. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-export-control/itar-usml-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: sanctions-export-control_eu-sanctions-screen
tools.description: Compare a name with the vendored EU consolidated list of persons, groups and entities subject to EU financial sanctions (every name and alias, all languages). Candidate matches carry the EU reference number, programmes and regulations and need human review. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-e

tools.name: sanctions-export-control_ca-sema-screen
tools.description: Compare a name with the vendored Canada consolidated Special Economic Measures Act (SEMA) sanctions list, including aliases. Candidate matches need human review. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-export-control/ca-sema-screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: sanctions-export-control_au-dfat-screen
tools.description: Compare a name, or a vessel IMO number, with the vendored DFAT Australian Sanctions Consolidated List. Candidate matches carry the reference, alias strength and measures and need human review. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-export-control/au-dfat-screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 pay

tools.name: sanctions-export-control_ofac-non-sdn-screen
tools.description: Compare a name with the vendored OFAC Consolidated (non-SDN) list: SSI, NS-MBS, CMIC, NS-PLC and CAPTA. SDN screening stays in exclusion.screen. Candidate matches need human review. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-export-control/ofac-non-sdn-screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment t

tools.name: sanctions-export-control_bis-denied-party-screen
tools.description: Compare a party name with the vendored BIS rows of the Consolidated Screening List: Entity List, Denied Persons List, Unverified List and Military End-User List. Candidate matches carry addresses, licence requirement and policy and need human review. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-export-c

tools.name: sanctions-export-control_ccl-eccn-lookup
tools.description: Return the Commerce Control List entry text for an ECCN, or ECCN headings matching keywords, from the vendored eCFR 15 CFR part 774 snapshot. Text lookup only, not an export classification. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-export-control/ccl-eccn-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payme

tools.name: sanctions-export-control_usml-category-lookup
tools.description: Return the USML (22 CFR 121.1) text for a category or paragraph, or paragraphs matching keywords, from the vendored eCFR snapshot. Not a jurisdiction or classification determination. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/sanctions-export-control/usml-category-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "sanctions-export-control" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
